configuration: A deterministic reduced configuration derived from test/thermal.jl with 20 graded timestep(s).
observable: final pressure, saturation, and temperature fields
default_vs_upstream: reduced spatial or temporal size while preserving the official production path
variant: one input changes from 500.0 to its adjacent Float64 value 500.00000000000006
altbuild: none: Julia 1.11.9 is the pinned supported runtime and the source package has no independent alternative native build

comparison.rule: Compare every Float64 value in final pressure, saturation, and temperature fields in documented array order using abs(candidate-reference) <= 1e-10 + 1e-8*abs(reference).

evidence.floor_how: two independent Docker nominal solves (20260916T233732Z and 20260917T000633Z) compared with validate.py were byte-identical

warrant: The bound grades pressure, saturation and temperature directly. Two independent Docker nominal solves had zero spread, while the approved hot-state variant used 5.95e-6 of the bound. A 1e-4 relative wrong-output probe was rejected.
